ALERT | Satellite imagery indicates North Korea is upgrading urban warfare training facilities at a major military base near Pyongyang.

The facilities have previously been linked to training North Korean forces deployed to support Russia in Ukraine.

The new activity comes amid

ALERT | India has summoned Pakistan’s top diplomat after Indian and Pakistani naval units collided at sea.

New Delhi blamed “unacceptable and unprofessional” actions by Pakistani forces for the incident, further raising tensions between the nuclear-armed neighbours.
